exam_scheme.note: The National Talent Search Examination (NTSE) is a prestigious flagship national scholarship programme conducted by the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT) for Class 10 students across India. The selection process operates at two levels: Stage I (State/UT Level) conducted by individual State/UT education departments/SCERTs, and Stage II (National Level) conducted by NCERT for candidates qualifying Stage I state quotas. Both stages consist of two written papers administered on the same day: Paper 1 (Mental Ability Test - MAT) comprising 100 MCQs on logical and analytical reasoning (100 marks, 120 minutes) and Paper 2 (Scholastic Aptitude Test - SAT) comprising 100 MCQs covering Science (40), Mathematics (20), and Social Science (40) (100 marks, 120 minutes). There is no negative marking in either paper. A total of 2,000 national scholarships are awarded annually.
